properties.description: Built 2026-10-17 in reflow2-mcp (PR #763). gaps_to_prompts and gap_to_prompt read only the replayed gap's id. describe_schema keeps to a named budget_chars (crate::schema_budget: detail withheld first, then lists shortened with all_names kept). add_verification's `verifies` states its shape in its first sentence, and the tool takes `computed`. A check whose location names a kept record cites it in reasoning_report. A capped get_instructions returns its first section whole with the manifest (budget.detail first_section_only) when it fits.
properties.name: The primes trial's tool snags are fixed: gap prompts by id, describe_schema within its budget, the verifies shape, a location-named record cited, and the first instructions section under a cap
